description: A common benign fibrous skin nodule, usually occurring on the limbs.
symptoms: May be mildly tender or itchy

appearance.general: A firm papule or nodule that is tethered to the skin and may dimple when pinched.
appearance.light_skin: May appear pink to light brown.
appearance.dark_skin: May appear dark brown to black; some lesions are paler centrally.

warning_signs: Recent enlargement, ulceration, or an atypical colour pattern warrants assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss any change in size, colour, symptoms, or diagnostic uncertainty.
